title: Rating Decisions on a Disability Compensation Award: Effective Dates and Combined Rating
content:
**1. Effective date of an increase.** An increase is effective on the date of claim or the date entitlement arose, whichever is later. When the evidence shows the increase was factually ascertainable within the increase look-back period before the date of claim, it is effective on the date the increase became ascertainable.

**2. Date of claim.** The date of claim is the received date of the claim, or the received date of the intent to file the claim cites.

**3. Past-due benefits — retired clause.** The clause under which past-due benefits for a favorable decision covered every entitlement month from the first month payable under the payment schedule through the last month already paid at the old rate, and equalled, for each such month, the new gross monthly entitlement minus the gross amount already paid for that month, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Award status for a decision.** A rating decision acts only on an award whose status is running or suspended. The status is taken from the award record of the award the decision acts on.

**5. Suspended awards.** Past-due benefits on a suspended award are computed but released only when the award resumes.

**6. Combined rating.** The combined rating is derived from the VA combined ratings table, applying the bilateral factor to disabilities of paired extremities first and rounding the combined value to the nearest rounding step, with values ending in 5 rounded up.

**7. Tier after a decision.** After a decision, the award carries the tier whose combined rating equals the decision's new combined rating.

**Status table for paragraph 4**

| Award status | A rating decision may act on it |
|---|---|
| Running | Yes |
| Suspended | Yes (any past-due is held until resumption) |
| Authorized | No |
| Terminated | No |

**Illustration of paragraphs 1 and 2 (hypothetical dates).** An intent to file was received on 3 February and the completed increase claim cites it, so the date of claim is 3 February. If entitlement arose on 10 March, the later of the two dates, 10 March, is the effective date. If instead the evidence showed the increase was factually ascertainable on 1 December of the prior year, within the look-back period before 3 February, the effective date is 1 December.

**Illustration of paragraph 7 (hypothetical).** A decision whose new combined rating is 70 percent leaves the award carrying Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating).

superseded_clauses: Past-due benefits for a favorable decision cover every entitlement month from the first month payable under the payment schedule through the last month already paid at the old rate, and equal, for each such month, the new gross monthly entitlement minus the gross amount already paid for that month.
